correctness.rationale: For connected graphs, exceptional braid-fan rays are exactly proper disconnected induced sets. Braid divisors meet iff their indices are comparable, and these indices form an antichain iff the complement has maximum degree at most one. For the matching case each missing pair is restored by the star subdivision at a smooth two-ray cone and distinct centers are disjoint; the star quotient has rays and maximal cones of the braid fan on n-2 remaining vertices, proving the center is Y_(n-2). The integral codimension-two blowup formula gives A_n(t)-r t A_(n-2)(t). Explicit n=3 boundary case is handled. Standard-library checker independently verifies 770 connected graph antichain cases and 16 matched-complement h-polynomials, but finite checks do not replace the proof.

value.rationale: The classification covers exactly all graphs for which this natural toric contraction has pairwise disjoint exceptional prime divisors, a geometric boundary rather than an arbitrary parameter slice. Uniform isomorphism of centers to smaller permutohedral varieties gives direct and motivated computation of integral Betti profiles, Euler characteristics, and Picard numbers for an infinite, geometrically distinguished family. It is neither a known-table reprint nor a numerical substitution: the graph-theoretic iff and blowup geometry are the asserted structural contribution.
